registered: 2026-10-20, before any v3 model was fitted

user_priorities.primary: few false positives (precision of Aedes alerts) over sensitivity
user_priorities.accepted: a short per-device/per-site calibration is acceptable

data.pool: v2 manifest (Dryad/Abuzz, HumBug-307, ESC-50, Pete noise, MosquitoSong, UFRGS-15) + BioDCASE 2026 CD-MSC development D1-D4 + full HumBugDB (Zenodo 4904800)

excluded.biodcase_D5: 5000-sample 8 kHz snippets of the six Wingbeats species = optical-sensor Wingbeats database (Fanioudakis et al. 2018), not microphone audio

data.deduplication: reanalysis/v3_dedup.py: exact PCM hash + spectral-peak landmark matching (validated 15/15 on resampled crops; max 5 votes between distinct files; link threshold >=12 votes and >=3% of query hashes). Linked files are merged into one component; a component is the smallest unit that may be split.
data.corpus_of_origin: each component is assigned to its original corpus (abuzz, humbug, mosquitosong, ufrgs, esc50, pete, or bdc_unknown when no link exists); BioDCASE domain labels are NOT used as domains because the stage-1 audit found D2 to contain 400 exact MosquitoSong files, D1 178 exact HumBug files, D4 167 exact Dryad/Abuzz files and species 8/9 clips copied across D1-D4
data.clusters: v2 rules (Dryad lab+device, HumBug country|place|device|setting|day, MosquitoSong individual, ESC-50 clip); bdc_unknown files: one cluster per BioDCASE domain x species (conservative); a component spanning clusters merges them

locked_final_test.definition: every component that contains a BioDCASE-D3 or UFRGS file and no file from any training corpus (abuzz, humbug, mosquitosong). This is the UFRGS smartphone/cup corpus (Brazil): Ae. aegypti females, Ae. albopictus, non-Aedes, plus any other D3 clips meeting the rule
locked_final_test.use: evaluated exactly once, after the final configuration is frozen; never used for fitting, selection, thresholds or calibration except in the pre-declared k-shot calibration arm, whose calibration files are drawn by fixed seed and excluded from its metrics
locked_final_test.note: 15 UFRGS files were already scored in v2; they are reported separately from the 190+ never-scored files

task.stage2: Aedes aegypti vs other mosquito, among files called mosquito
task.operating_point: Aedes alert only if calibrated p(Aedes) >= tau; tau chosen on inner validation as the smallest value with FPR(other mosquito) <= 2% and FPR(noise) <= 1%
task.abstention: agreement gate: if the embedding model and the wingbeat-descriptor model disagree on Aedes vs not-Aedes, output 'uncertain'

features.perch: Perch 2.0 frozen embedding (ONNX port, sha256 bf0c8467...), 8 kHz band-limited audio upsampled to 32 kHz, 5 s chunks, unit RMS (reanalysis/v3_embed.py)
features.perch_whitened: same after per-recording noise-floor whitening (20th percentile STFT magnitude)
features.wingbeat: v2 descriptors (f0 250-1000 Hz, harmonic ratios, centroid, bandwidth, flatness) on whitened audio
features.v2_tabular: v2 log-mel statistics on whitened audio (baseline)

models.A_logreg: logistic regression on perch (C grid 0.01/0.1/1 by inner CV)
models.B_mlp_mmd: 1-hidden-layer MLP (256) on perch, cross-entropy + lambda*MMD (Gaussian kernel, median heuristic) between training corpora on the hidden layer, lambda grid 0/0.3/1; no backbone fine-tuning, no domain rebalancing
models.D_v2_hgb: v2 HistGradientBoosting on whitened v2 tabular features (reference)
models.weights: each file total weight 1, classes equal total weight; corpora NOT rebalanced
models.aggregation: file score = mean chunk log-probability, softmax

evaluation.primary_LODO: leave-one-corpus-out over Aedes-bearing training corpora {abuzz, humbug, mosquitosong}; noise corpora always in training; inner model selection by cluster-grouped 3-fold CV inside the training corpora
evaluation.secondary_pooled: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by cluster over all training corpora
evaluation.kshot: for each held-out corpus: k in {5,10,20} files per class from k distinct clusters when possible (seed 20261023, 5 repeats) refit only the classifier head with the calibration files weighted x5, threshold kept from the source model; evaluate on the remaining clusters
evaluation.metrics: Aedes precision, recall, FPR in other mosquito and in noise, coverage (non-uncertain fraction), AUROC Aedes-vs-rest, AUPRC, balanced accuracy; 95% CI by cluster bootstrap (2000)
evaluation.decision_rule_for_final_config: highest mean LODO Aedes precision at recall >= 0.2; ties by AUROC; chosen before opening the locked test

interpretation.success: on the locked test, Aedes precision CI lower bound > prevalence of Aedes in that test and FPR(other mosquito) <= 5%
